# EternaX Labs

> EternaX is post-quantum security engineering for institutional digital assets. Market infrastructures, banks and transfer agents use it to keep control over who can move their assets: one NIST post-quantum authorization policy at their control points, under the custody, tokenization and EVM systems they already operate, on their own network or on Ethereum, so participants and custodians inherit it without changing their stacks, and the institution picks and rotates the algorithm itself. The cryptography is published with the University of British Columbia and implemented in open source, and the controls run on unmodified Besu today.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://eternax.ai/): Post-quantum control plane for institutional digital assets, on the institution's own network or on Ethereum: the authorization path, the three product surfaces (custody, tokenization, Besu/EVM), evidence, exposure map, and pilot.
- [Why EternaX](https://eternax.ai/why-eternax.html): PQ-native rationale, performance comparison, and institutional positioning.
- [Pilot Programme](https://eternax.ai/pilot.html): Three enterprise pilot paths — stablecoin issuance, tokenized funds/RWAs, and post-quantum custody/MPC authorization.
- [Testnet](https://eternax.ai/pluto-testnet.html): Pluto testnet access — web wallet, block explorer, CLI tools, RPC endpoints.
- [About EternaX Labs](https://eternax.ai/about.html): Canonical entity page for founders, mission, and company profile.
- [Glossary](https://eternax.ai/glossary.html): Definitions for post-quantum cryptography and migration terminology.
- [Blog Index](https://eternax.ai/blogs/index.html): Research reports and blog archive.
- [Reports Index](https://eternax.ai/reports/index.html): Institutional post-quantum research reports archive.

## Solutions

- [Stablecoin Issuers](https://eternax.ai/stablecoin-issuers.html): Post-quantum verification for mint, burn, freeze, blacklist and treasury authority on existing token contracts. For stablecoin issuers, tokenized-deposit programmes, payment networks, and banks.
- [Tokenized Funds & RWAs](https://eternax.ai/tokenized-funds-rwas.html): PQ Vault, PQ-ONCHAINID, PQ-Permit and PQ-4626 for issuer, compliance, approval and governance controls on existing EVM deployments. For asset managers, transfer agents and RWA platforms.
- [Custody & MPC Providers](https://eternax.ai/custody-mpc-providers.html): Dual-gate post-quantum custody authorization under MPC, HSM and Safe-style custody. Preserve distributed approval without threshold SLH-DSA; signature-agnostic policy for algorithm rotation.

- [Reports Index](https://eternax.ai/reports/index.html): All institutional post-quantum research reports.
- [Non-Upgradeable Chains & DeFi Exposure Report](https://eternax.ai/post-quantum-non-upgradeable-chains-defi-exposure-report.html): Why chain upgrades cannot fix immutable contracts, frozen standards, and DeFi liquidity on Ethereum, Solana, and Canton.
- [Post-Quantum MPC Custody Crisis 2026](https://eternax.ai/post_quantum_mpc_custody_crisis_hash_based_sphincs_institutional.html): 15 institutional MPC providers, $10T+ in assets, zero post-quantum safe custody.
- [Post-Quantum Exposure Map 2026](https://eternax.ai/post_quantum_exposure_map_institutional_crypto_tokenized_assets.html): Institutional exposure map for 20+ institutions, tokenized assets, stablecoins, RWAs, collateral, and privacy.
